domain(person,[santana,anahi,davina]).

axiom(s1, rule([or(listens_actively(X), shares_stories(X))], forge_meaningful_connections(X))).

axiom(s2, not(try_new_food(santana))).
% Anahi speaks multiple languages.
axiom(s3, speaks_multiple_languages(anahi)).

axiom(s4, forall(var(x,person), or(values_kindness(var(x)), has_empathy(var(x))))).
% If Davina is open-minded, then she either shares personal stories or forges meaningful connections (but not both).
axiom(s5, rule([open_minded(davina)], xor(shares_personal_stories(davina), forge_meaningful_connections(davina)))).
% Anahi either receives warm hospitality or travels alone, but not both.
axiom(s6, xor(receives_warm_hospitality(anahi), travels_alone(anahi))).
% Anahi does not foster global understanding.
axiom(s7, not(foster_global_understanding(anahi))).
% Anyone who is sociable or has empathy can build bridges between people.
axiom(s8, rule([or(sociable(X), has_empathy(X))], build_bridges_between_people(X))).
% Anahi enjoys solitude.
axiom(s9, enjoys_solitude(anahi)).
% If Anahi either prioritizes community or enjoys solitude (but not both), then she is sociable.
axiom(s10, rule([xor(prioritizes_community(anahi), enjoys_solitude(anahi))], sociable(anahi))).
% Anahi does not love adventure.
axiom(s11, not(love_adventure(anahi))).

axiom(s12, rule([and(has_empathy(X), speaks_multiple_languages(X))], foster_global_understanding(X))).
% Anahi cannot build bridges between people.
axiom(s13, not(build_bridges_between_people(anahi))).

axiom(s14, not(try_new_food(anahi))).
% If Anahi has travel stories and documents experiences, then she can explore cities.
axiom(s15, rule([and(has_travel_stories(anahi), documents_experiences(anahi))], explore_cities(anahi))).
% If Anahi either has no fixed address or keeps to herself (but not both), then she tends to travel alone.
axiom(s16, rule([xor(has_no_fixed_address(anahi), keeps_to_herself(anahi))], travels_alone(anahi))).
% If Anahi explores cities or tries new food, then she loves adventure.
axiom(s17, rule([or(explore_cities(anahi), try_new_food(anahi))], love_adventure(anahi))).
% Anahi either values independence or prioritizes community, but not both.
axiom(s18, xor(values_independence(anahi), prioritizes_community(anahi))).
% If Anahi is open-minded, then she either shares personal stories or forges meaningful connections (but not both).
axiom(s19, rule([open_minded(anahi)], xor(shares_personal_stories(anahi), forge_meaningful_connections(anahi)))).
% Santana does not love adventure.
axiom(s20, not(love_adventure(santana))).
% Anahi is open-minded.
axiom(s21, open_minded(anahi)).
% Anahi does not share personal stories.
axiom(s22, not(shares_personal_stories(anahi))).
